achievements.name: First Floor
achievements.detail: Clear level 1-1 inside the Mario Toy Company.

achievements.name: Key and Door
achievements.detail: Pick up a key and carry it to the locked door.

achievements.name: Toy Box
achievements.detail: Guide the Mini-Marios into an open toy box.

achievements.name: Present Hunter
achievements.detail: Collect every present in a regular level.

achievements.name: World Boss
achievements.detail: Defeat Donkey Kong at the end of a world.

achievements.name: Donkey Kong Jungle
achievements.detail: Clear every course in Donkey Kong Jungle.

achievements.name: Eight Worlds
achievements.detail: Finish all eight main worlds, from the Mario Toy Company through Twilight City.

achievements.name: Perfect Rating
achievements.detail: Earn a Perfect rating, shown as a gold star, by fully clearing a level.

achievements.name: Two-Player
achievements.detail: Clear a level in local two-player mode with the second player controlling Toad.

achievements.name: Bonus Chest
achievements.detail: Catch the flying key in a bonus level and open the chest before time runs out.

achievements.name: Expert Level
achievements.detail: Unlock an Expert level with gold stars and clear it.

achievements.name: Story's End
achievements.detail: Win the final battle against Donkey Kong and stay for the ending.
